definitions.coefficients: C=<w cos>, S=<w sin>; horizontal average over L
definitions.energy: L integral_z (C^2+S^2); vertical composite Simpson on rows/midrows
definitions.difference: subtract matched real coefficients before computing mode energy
definitions.fit: sigma=0.5 slope(log energy); window is supplied explicitly
definitions.uncertainty: OLS error excludes discretization error and base drift
definitions.acceptance: fits alone do not certify an eigenmode, resolution or linear regime
